# Taylor Brothers Fire And Safety

> Full-service fire safety and security provider offering suppression systems, life safety solutions, and comprehensive facility protection for industrial, commercial, and specialized applications.

Taylor Brothers Fire And Safety, operating under the Iridium Protection brand, serves the Treasure Valley region with expert installation, maintenance, and monitoring of fire suppression, life safety, and security systems. The company specializes in clean-agent systems, kitchen exhaust protection, and industrial plant safety solutions.

## Key Topics

- Fire Suppression Systems
- Life Safety & Fire Alarms
- Clean Agent Systems (INERGEN, FM-200, SAPPHIRE)
- Kitchen Exhaust Protection
- Data Center Protection
- Security Services & Monitoring
- UL 300 Compliance
- NFPA 72 Standards
- Industrial Plant Safety
- 24/7 Monitoring
- Ansul, Fenwal, Kidde Products
- Powder Coating Booths
- Access Control & Surveillance
- Installation & Maintenance Services

## Core Services

- [Fire Suppression Systems](https://taylorbrosfs.com/services/fire-suppression): Fire suppression systems including INERGEN, FM-200, and SAPPHIRE clean-agent solutions for industrial, data center, and specialized applications
- [Life Safety & Fire Alarms](https://taylorbrosfs.com/services/life-safety): Life safety and fire alarm systems with NFPA 72 compliance and 24/7 monitoring capabilities
- [Security Services](https://taylorbrosfs.com/services/security): Comprehensive security services including surveillance systems, access control, and professional monitoring

## Products & Solutions

- [Products Catalog](https://taylorbrosfs.com/products): Complete product lineup featuring Ansul, Fenwal, and Kidde fire safety and suppression solutions
- [Fire Suppression Solutions](https://taylorbrosfs.com/services/fire-supression): Specialized fire suppression systems for industrial plants, data centers, kitchen exhaust protection, and powder coating booths
